WITH SOTMP AS ( SELECT SO.TRADE_ID, SO.SETTLE_DATE, SOE.IS_TRADE
,SO.ORDER_ID
FROM STL_ORDERS SO,STL_ORDERS_EXT SOE WHERE SO.ORDER_ID = SOE.ORDER_ID AND SOE.IS_TRADE = 'N' ) SELECT T.FINPROD_TYPE finprodtype,
T.BUSI_TYPE as busiType,
T.PS, SUM(NVL(T.PRIN_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) prinamt, SUM(NVL(T.INT_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) intamt, SUM(NVL(T.TRADE_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) tradeamt FROM ( SELECT DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE,
DEAL.BUSI_TYPE,
DEAL.PS, DEAL.PRIN_AMT, NVL(OT.SETTLE_DATE, DEAL.SETTLE_DATE) SETTLE_DATE, DEAL.INT_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_STATUS from (SELECT A.FINPROD_TYPE,
A.BUSI_TYPE,
A.TRADE_ID, /** A.PS,modify by yanya on 20200222 期权**/ CASE WHEN A.FINPROD_TYPE='F35' THEN CASE WHEN A.PS = 'T01' THEN FP.EXC_PS||'_'||A.PS WHEN A.PS IN ('T59','T60') THEN FP.EXC_PS||'_'||A.PS||'_'||A.PS_PAYMENT END ELSE A.PS END PS, /**A.SETTLE_DATE,**/ NVL(A.SETTLE_DATE,A.TRADE_DATE) AS SETTLE_DATE, CASE WHEN A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17' AND A.PS = 'T02' AND A.busi_type = '09' THEN A.CPRICE_AMT WHEN A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' AND A.PS NOT IN ('T25','T26') THEN A.CPRICE_AMT ELSE A.PRIN_AMT END PRIN_AMT, A.INT_AMT, A.TRADE_AMT, A.TRADE_STATUS /** ,finTrade.EXC_PS**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A /** add by yanya on 20200222 期权**/ LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FP ON A.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID AND FP.BRANCH=0 INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON B.BUSI_NO = A.TRADE_ID
AND B.BOOKSET_ID in
#{item}
/** left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT finTrade on finTrade.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F35' and finTrade.finprod_id = A.finprod_id**/ /**UNION ALL **/ UNION SELECT D.FINPROD_TYPE,
D.BUSI_TYPE, D.TRADE_ID,
/** D.PS,modify by yanya on 20200222 期权**/ CASE WHEN D.FINPROD_TYPE='F35' THEN CASE WHEN D.PS = 'T01' THEN FP.EXC_PS||'_'||D.PS WHEN D.PS IN ('T59','T60') THEN FP.EXC_PS||'_'||D.PS||'_'||D.PS_PAYMENT END ELSE D.PS END PS, /**D.SETTLE_DATE SETTLE_DATE,**/ NVL(D.SETTLE_DATE,D.TRADE_DATE) SETTLE_DATE, CASE WHEN D.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17' AND D.PS = 'T02' AND D.busi_type = '09' THEN D.CPRICE_AMT WHEN D.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' AND D.PS NOT IN ('T25','T26') THEN D.CPRICE_AMT ELSE D.PRIN_AMT END PRIN_AMT, D.INT_AMT, D.TRADE_AMT, D.TRADE_STATUS /**,finTrade.EXC_PS**/ FROM STL_ORDERS C INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL D ON C.TRADE_ID = D.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FP ON D.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID AND FP.BRANCH=0 INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING E ON E.BUSI_NO = C.ORDER_ID
AND E.BOOKSET_ID in
#{item}
/**left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT finTrade on finTrade.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F35' and finTrade.finprod_id = D.finprod_id **/ ) DEAL LEFT JOIN SOTMP OT ON DEAL.TRADE_ID = OT.TRADE_ID ) T WHERE TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{vdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.FINPROD_TYPE,T.PS
,T.BUSI_TYPE

WITH SOTMP AS ( SELECT SO.TRADE_ID, SO.SETTLE_DATE, SOE.IS_TRADE FROM STL_ORDERS SO,STL_ORDERS_EXT SOE WHERE SO.ORDER_ID = SOE.ORDER_ID AND SOE.IS_TRADE = 'N' ) SELECT T.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, T.FINPROD_TYPE finprodtype, T.PS, SUM(NVL(T.PRIN_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) prinamt, SUM(NVL(T.INT_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) intamt, SUM(NVL(T.TRADE_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) tradeamt FROM ( SELECT BDA.BOOKSET_ID, DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, DEAL.PS, NVL(OT.SETTLE_DATE,DEAL.SETTLE_DATE) SETTLE_DATE, DEAL.PRIN_AMT, DEAL.INT_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_STATUS FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING BDA ON BDA.BUSI_NO = DEAL.TRADE_ID
AND BDA.BOOKSET_ID in
#{item}
LEFT JOIN SOTMP OT ON DEAL.TRADE_ID = OT.TRADE_ID ) T WHERE TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{vdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.BOOKSET_ID,T.FINPROD_TYPE,T.PS
SELECT TO_CHAR(B.BOOKSET_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') reportDate FROM bok_bookset_date B WHERE B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(B.BOOKSET_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') reportDate FROM SYS_BATCH_GRP_PRDLINK A LEFT JOIN bok_bookset_date B ON A.PRODUCT_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID WHERE A.GROUP_SEQ = #{booksetGroup}
